html:
Aoe Spammer

Hi I am Art and perhaps i invented a class noone has used before me. I been using it since lvl 52 and im lvl 100 now, 2 guys copied me and its their new favorite class... Its then i thought of making this page to guide u in class of awesomness :D

First of all

Basic stats

Ocationally its mage extenction to the other lvl... it meens just put everything on INT (intelect) and rest u get from gear (such as endurance for survival and agility for Dungeon Inferno)

Total Stats

on lvl 100 its good to have hp at 9k - 10k and mana 40k + attack rating (as need for dungeon inferno) should be atleast 3k

Skills

L - Is super Effective and Supportive AoE for other players (as curse +% to fire taken damage ca stack up to 3 times)

1 - Good with Oh Snap! passive, debuffs and damages enemies

2 - Supportive to Shadow Mages with you (as +% to shadow taken damage stacks), and also deals good damage

3 - Supportive to paladins around u (as +% to all divine taken damage stacks), Is Good if you are cornered

4 - Is needed for your survival as most of damage taken goes to mana

5 - Really handy for boss rooms(if you dont have it use ring of fire)

6 - Image:Oh snap.jpg PLEASE NOTE: i didnt found image for Oh Snap! skill!!!! Oh Snap is handy passive skill, it will add debuff and extra damage to ur Snap

7 - Adds damage to your magic attacks

8 - More MANA!!!!!

R - Here is ur main skill, use it between AoE's

Equipment

Good thing about AoE spammers, all u need to have is ballance hp/mana, attack rating, and have a ranged weapon. Bonuses, dont be picky, what ever u will use (either fire/ice/shadow or split) will add to your over all damage. Aka +200 ice helps as much as +200 shadow bonus. My suggestion go split :) its not a must thou.

Strategy

Strategy of AoE spammers is simple Use all AoE till everyone dies. When a cooldown ends cast an AoE emidiatly (unless its only one enemy).


Thats it :)

if u liked that classmake your own AoE spammer now and try it out... ITS PURE PvE PWNAGE :D

Have fun ;)
